'''Mark II ''Katarn''-class commando armor''' was a type of armor worn by [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic Commandos]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the successor to the Mark I armor. Based on recommendations by [[Omega Squad]] after the events on [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]], Mark II armor [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] was hardened against EMP and was resistant to [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Verpine shatter gun|shatter gun]] rounds. Mark II armor was strong enough to withstand contact blast from a grenade.
